audio.strategy: Locally generated additive piano synthesis rendered into Web Audio buffers; no network or recorded sample assets are used.

generatedSources.name: Stage 4 Phase 1 additive piano voice
generatedSources.source: Original deterministic harmonic synthesis in candidate/src/audio.ts (renderPianoWave), rendered separately per MIDI pitch and velocity-scaled through the live Web Audio gain envelope.
generatedSources.license: Original implementation code; no third-party audio asset.
generatedSources.notes: The tone uses five inharmonic sine partials and a natural decay. This is generated synthesis, not a recording or sample library.

notes: Audio is created only after user note input and routed through one master gain node.
All held sources are released on blur, hidden document, MIDI disconnect, and component cleanup.
No external URL is required for audio or rendering.
